APP.TITLE: Blackjack Assistant
APP.DESCRIPTION: The Blackjack Assistant is a simple tool that helps blackjack players track cards and calculate probabilities.

RULES.TITLE: Blackjack Rules
RULES.DESCRIPTION: Learn the basic rules of Blackjack to play confidently.
RULES.RULE_1: Try to get as close to 21 as possible without going over.
RULES.RULE_2: Beat the dealer’s hand without going over 21.
RULES.RULE_3: Face cards are worth 10, and Aces are worth 1 or 11.
